meta.title: Baptiste Gosselin, infrastructure, code and theater
meta.description: Computer science student in Caen, France. I build infrastructure (Kubernetes, networking, Go) and I do theater. Looking for an apprenticeship for 2026-2027.

hero.stageDirection: The curtain rises. A ghost light was left on, network cables trail across the stage.
hero.line: Hello. I'm Baptiste. I study computer science in Caen, France, and I take care of what nobody sees: infrastructure. Kubernetes clusters, networking, an orchestrator written in Go. And when the servers run on their own, I go on stage.
hero.status: He is looking for an apprenticeship for the 2026-2027 season.

notices.title: Apprenticeship
notices.text: I've already built a Kubernetes cluster and its network for UnxWares. Now I'm looking for a team that does this at a larger scale, trusts me with real responsibilities, and keeps me for a year.

notices.title: Internship
notices.text: An internship to get my hands on infrastructure running in production: cloud, containers, CI/CD or system administration.
